title: Expand only the declared repeatable-annotation container
summary: The merged annotation stream ignored the lookalike container and kept the real repeated tags. Java reflection still retrieved the nested decoy from the unrelated annotation.

change.description: Standard repeatable detection now verifies that the component annotation names the candidate container in @Repeatable. An unrelated array-valued annotation previously qualified by shape alone.

notes: The official-container check preserves JDK declaration order and compares the Spring results as a multiset.
